On a sunny sandy beach with dunes in the background, the man in the black wetsuit (R1) and the boy in the black and blue wetsuit (R2) walk forward side-by-side while holding hands. The man (R1) carries a surfboard under his left arm, looking upward with a smile. Beside him, the boy (R2) walks with his eyes closed and head tilted slightly up. The image features bright, warm backlighting that creates a soft lens flare and a hazy, atmospheric look.
